title: Ruby and Wesley
style: Phonk with dusty cowbell loops and a half-time bounce, cruising at a mid-tempo drag; intro opens with vinyl crackle and a filtered bass pulse, verse section keeps it skeletal with clipped kick, snapped snare, and a warped whistle motif, then a drop brings thicker sub, rattling shaker grid, and chopped chant stabs. Short break sections use reversed swells and tape-stop turns, final passage adds gang-style vocal chops and a sun-baked percussion layer. Dark, gritty, wide, and punchy with a humid tropical edge.
